"""
Domain model for data collected with the PROCERTUS identificatiefiche
(productie-eenheid / distributiecentrum / verhuurbedrijf).

Maps to: `identificatiefiche-digitized.md` and related screenshots.
Expose or compose this fragment in your API schema as needed.
"""

"""Kind of organizational unit (PE / DC / VHB)."""
enum OrganizationalUnitKind {
  PRODUCTION_UNIT
  DISTRIBUTION_CENTER
  RENTAL_COMPANY
}

"""
Postal-style address. Use `lines` for free-text capture; structured
fields optional when parsed or validated.
"""
type Address {
  """Address lines in order (e.g. street, box, building)."""
  lines: [String!]!
  locality: String
  postalCode: String
  region: String
  """ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code when known."""
  countryCode: String
}

"""
Natural person used as legal representative, unit responsible contact,
or certification / invoicing contact.
"""
type Person {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  title: String
  telephone: String
  email: String!
}

"""
Shared shape for a company (firma) and an operational unit (PE / DC / VHB).
"""
interface OrganizationalEntity {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  address: Address!
  """Primary telephone for the entity (e.g. firma- or eenheid-level)."""
  phone: String!
  """
  Legal or operational representative: wettelijke vertegenwoordiger (firma)
  or verantwoordelijke (eenheid), depending on entity type.
  """
  representative: Person!
}

"""
Registered organization (holding / firma) that may own several units.
Carries a VAT number; units do not use this type’s VAT field.
"""
type Company implements OrganizationalEntity {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  address: Address!
  phone: String!
  representative: Person!

  """BTW-nummer (VAT) — organization level only."""
  vatNumber: String!

  """Production units, distribution centres, rental companies, etc."""
  units: [OrganizationalUnit!]!

  """
  Primary contact for all PROCERTUS communication regarding certification
  (extranet account holder for the PE/DC/VHB context).
  """
  certificationAndInspectionContact: Person!

  """
  Optional second recipient for PROCERTUS communications on certification
  and inspection (when applicable).
  """
  certificationAndInspectionSecondaryContact: Person

  """
  Billing details for this company. Entire block optional until provided;
  when present, apply validation (e.g. invoicing email required per form).
  """
  invoicing: CompanyInvoicingDetails
}

"""
Single operational unit belonging to a `Company`.
"""
type OrganizationalUnit implements OrganizationalEntity {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  address: Address!
  phone: String!
  representative: Person!

  unitKind: OrganizationalUnitKind!

  """Owning company (navigation / integrity)."""
  company: Company!
}

"""
Invoicing preferences for a company.

Business rule (paper form): either attribute billing to a dedicated person
or supply a standalone invoicing email when that mailbox is not tied to a
`Person` record (or both if your process allows).
"""
type CompanyInvoicingDetails {
  """Optional: person responsible for or named on invoices."""
  responsiblePerson: Person

  """
  Email address for invoicing when there is no dedicated `responsiblePerson`
  or when billing mail must go to a functional mailbox.
  """
  invoicingEmail: String

  """
  Billing address when it differs from the company’s primary `address`
  on `Company`. Omit when the same as the organization address.
  """
  invoicingAddressOverride: Address
}

content.text:
### Why those types aren’t plain `z.infer<typeof companySchema>`

`Company` and `OrganizationalUnit` reference each other (`units` ↔ `company`), so the schemas have to use **`z.lazy()`**. With that pattern, each lazy factory closes over the other schema while TypeScript is still trying to **infer** the first one’s type. That creates a **cycle in type inference**, and the compiler bails out with **`TS7022`** (“implicitly has type `any` … referenced in its own initializer”).

So TypeScript **cannot** infer those two types from the schemas alone. You have to **break the cycle** by giving an explicit type somewhere. The usual options are:

1. **`export type X = …` / `interface`** for the recursive pair (what we use), plus **`z.ZodType<Company>`** / **`z.ZodType<OrganizationalUnit>`** on the lazy schemas, or  
2. A **type assertion** on the lazy schema (still needs a written `Company` / `OrganizationalUnit`-shaped type to assert to).

Non-recursive pieces (`Address`, `Person`, `CompanyInvoicingDetails`, etc.) don’t have that problem, so they stay as **`z.infer<typeof …>`** only.

The **real source of truth** for field-level validation is still the **`z.object({ … })`** inside the lazy callbacks; the two exported types are the minimal typings TypeScript needs so those callbacks aren’t `any`.

A file-level comment was added at the top of `identificatiefiche-zod.ts` so this is documented next to the code.

Here is what was implemented.

### Domain (`@procertus-ui/domain-certification`)

- New [`identificatiefiche-form-schemas.ts`](packages/_certification-domain-certification/src/identificatiefiche-form-schemas.ts): builds on `personSchema` / `addressSchema` with  
  `identificatiePersonCaptureSchema`, `identificatiePersonSubformValueSchema`, `personSubformValueToCapture`, `finalizePersonCapture`, `identificatieStreetAddressCaptureSchema`, `streetAddressCaptureToAddress`, `customerContextToFirmaAddressCapture`, `isFirmaAddressCaptureComplete`, `isOnboardingInvoicingCaptureValid`.

### Onboarding state

- [`anonymous-onboarding-types.ts`](packages/ui-certification/src/anonymous-onboarding/anonymous-onboarding-types.ts): `CustomerContext` extended with **§1** `firmaPhone`, `legalRepresentativePhone`, `addressCountryCode`; **§3** `addCertificationContactOverride` + `certificationContact`; **§4** `addCertificationSecondaryContact` + `certificationSecondary`; **§5** invoicing toggles and fields (contact/department, email, optional person slice, optional invoicing address).  
  `IdentificatiePersonCaptureState` is the domain `IdentificatiePersonSubformValue`.

### Helpers & validation

- [`anonymous-onboarding-flow-helpers.tsx`](packages/ui-certification/src/anonymous-onboarding/anonymous-onboarding-flow-helpers.tsx): defaults + **nested** normalization, `mergeCustomerContextDeep`, `legalRepresentativePersonValue`, `isLegalRepresentativePersonValid`, `isOnboardingCompanyStepValid` (optional blocks use the same Zod rules), `firmaAddressSubformValue` / `invoicingAddressSubformValue`, richer `buildRows`, `hasStructuredPostalAddress` via `isFirmaAddressCaptureComplete`.

### Hook & props

- [`use-anonymous-onboarding-flow.tsx`](packages/ui-certification/src/anonymous-onboarding/use-anonymous-onboarding-flow.tsx): `hasCustomerContext` / `hasCompanyContext` use the helpers above; **`patchContext`** (deep merge + hint clearing on address-like patches); `viewProps` includes `patchContext`.

### UI building blocks

- New [`identificatie-subforms.tsx`](packages/ui-certification/src/anonymous-onboarding/identificatie-subforms.tsx): **`IdentificatiePersonSubform`** (with optional locked title), **`IdentificatieAddressSubform`** (herbruikbaar adres), **`IdentificatieOptionalBlock`** (titel + beschrijving + **Switch**; kinderen alleen als aan).

### Flow view

- [`anonymous-onboarding-flow-view.tsx`](packages/ui-certification/src/anonymous-onboarding/anonymous-onboarding-flow-view.tsx): step titles/descriptions refer explicitly to the **identificatiefiche** en Zod-schema’s; **Registratie** uses the person subform + titel-presets; **Firma** uses naam, telefoon firma, adres-subform (→ `identificatieStreetAddressCaptureSchema`), then optionele blokken voor PROCERTUS-contacten en facturatie (met geneste switches voor uitgebreide factuurpersoon en afwijkend factuuradres).

### App

- [`mergeStoredOnboardingCustomerContext.ts`](apps/frontend-pt1-extranet-onboarding/src/features/profile/mergeStoredOnboardingCustomerContext.ts): **deep merge** for the three person-slices so partial profile updates don’t wipe nested objects.

### Exports

- `IdentificatiePersonCaptureState` is exported from `@procertus-ui/ui-certification`.

`bunx tsc -b` succeeds for **frontend-pt1-extranet-onboarding**; **domain-certification** `tsc` passes; **oxlint** is clean on the touched onboarding files. The full **ui-certification** package `tsc` still reports bestaande monorepo/Storybook issues unrelated to this change.

Here is what was implemented.

### New step: **Land of regio** (`origin`)
- Inserted **after** the certification wizard finishes and **before** registratie (`customer`).
- Five **choice cards**: België, Nederland, een ander Europees land (EU, niet BE/NL), Verenigde Staten, Anders.
- Flow order is now: **request → origin → customer → company → summary**.
- The unused **`review`** entry was removed from `ONBOARDING_STEPS` (it was never shown and broke stepper indices).

### State
- `AnonymousOnboardingFlowState` has **`requestOrigin: OnboardingRequestOrigin | ""`** (`be` | `nl` | `eu` | `us` | `other`).
- Finishing the wizard sets **`step: "origin"`** (no longer jumps straight to customer).
- **Legacy localStorage** without `requestOrigin`: field defaults to `""` and progress is sent back to **`origin`** when there are drafts.

### Behaviour after the choice
1. **Demo VAT-scenario’s** are filtered by region (e.g. only BE for België, NL for Nederland, DE/FR voor EU, US voor VS, ruimere set voor “Anders”).
2. **Standaard preset** per regio wordt gezet (BE → `be-kbo`, NL → `nl-kvk`, EU → `de-partial`, US → `us-international`, Anders → `fr-manual`). Als de huidige preset niet meer mag, wordt hij automatisch gecorrigeerd.
3. **Land-selectie** (hoofdadres enz.) gebruikt een **smal of breed landenlijst** afhankelijk van `requestOrigin` (zie `registrationCountryOptionsForRequestOrigin` in `onboarding-request-origin.ts`).

### Bestanden (hoofdzakelijk)
- `onboarding-request-origin.ts` – types, labels, preset- en landenlogica.
- `anonymous-onboarding-types.ts` – stappen + `requestOrigin` op flow state.
- `use-anonymous-onboarding-flow.tsx` – stepper, guards, `setRequestOrigin`, country/preset filtering, migratie.
- `anonymous-onboarding-flow-view.tsx` – `SelectChoiceCardGroup` voor de keuze; preset-dropdown gebruikt gefilterde lijst; **`customerContextAfterPrototypePresetChange`** voor preset-wissels.

- The optional block and field are gone from the UI.
- Persisted state is normalized: `addInvoicingSupplementaryDetails` is forced off and `invoicingContactOrDepartment` is cleared on load (types kept for backward compatibility).

- The same `IdentificatieOptionalBlock` + `IdentificatieAddressSubform` now sits on **Bedrijfsgegevens**, after the firma-adres, still driven by `addInvoicingAddressOverride`.
- It was removed from the **extras** step.

- **Uitgebreide contactpersoon voor facturatie** (unchanged pattern, registry picker kept).
- **Ander hoofdcontact voor certificatie en inspectie** removed end-to-end from the UI; `addCertificationContactOverride` is always cleared in normalization (legacy fields remain on the type).

### Rules for the second contact (your cut-off sentence)
This matches the intended gating: the second contact stays **disabled** until **“Uitgebreide contactpersoon voor facturatie”** is on **and** that person is **complete** (name + valid e-mail). Hints are updated so they no longer refer to the removed hoofdcontact override.

- Stepper/fixture description for extras: **“Factuurcontact en tweede certificatiecontact (optioneel)”**.
- Removed unused `titleLabelForPresetId` import; `oxlint` is clean on the touched onboarding files.

Here is what changed:

### 1. **Facturatie (losstaand)**
- Optionele kaart **“Contactpersoon voor facturatie”**: zelfde patroon als eerder (schakelaar + **Persoon kiezen** uit het register of **nieuw** via subform).
- Uitzetten wist alleen de factuurcontact-slot; **certificatie/inspectie** blijft ongemoeid.

### 2. **Certificatie en inspectie (los van facturatie)**
- Nieuwe/teruggebrachte kaart **“Contactpersoon voor certificatie en inspectie”** op `addCertificationContactOverride`.
- Tekst maakt expliciet **“Los van facturatie”**.
- Registry-picker + `IdentificatiePersonTitleRoleCapture` (nieuw/bestaand), zoals voorheen.
- `syncOnboardingRegisteredPersons` vult dit weer als **“Certificatie en inspectie”** in het persoonsregister.

### 3. **Tweede / reserve-contact (alleen na hoofd-certcontact)**
- **“Tweede contactpersoon (reserve certificatie en inspectie)”** is weer een **derde**, losstaande optie.
- **Ingeschakeld** alleen als het hoofdcontact certificatie/inspectie aan staat **en** volledig geldig is (`canEnableCertificationSecondaryContact` is daaraar gekoppeld, niet meer aan facturatie).
- Opnieuw **Persoon kiezen** (bestaand of nieuw) + title/role-capture, net als het hoofdcontact.
- Uitzetten van het hoofdcontact wist automatisch het reserve-contact (normalize + UI `onCheckedChange`).

### 4. **Persistente state & demo**
- Normalisatie **forceert `addCertificationContactOverride` niet meer uit**; wist nog wel legacy **extra factuurregel**-velden.
